name: Sable Labyr
source:
Sable is an aspiring magic researcher who often allows his obsession to get the best of him. To Sable, sleep and food are a waste of time, and other human beings are mere distractions. All that matters is his research. 

While Sable is typically disinterested in other people, demi-humans and other prominent mages are an exception. Sable is interested in demi-humans to the point where some might find his fascination downright creepy.

He is one of the few 1st year students that can use the advance spell 'Terminal', and are one the fortunate few around the world that can see aether; the mystical energy which courses through the bodies of all living things and everywhere around the surroundings; with his own eyes.
